nom: Embryolisse Lait-Crème Fluid+ Face & Body Cream, Multi-Use Lightweight Moisturizer with Shea Butter & Aloe Vera. Fast Absorbing, For All Skin Types

avis.texte: Here’s a positive review you can use: Embryolisse Lait-Crème Fluid+ is an amazing moisturizer for both face and body. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and hydrated without any greasy residue. It works well under makeup and keeps my skin moisturized throughout the day. I also appreciate that it’s gentle enough for sensitive skin and doesn’t cause irritation. A little goes a long way, making it a great value. This has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for an effective everyday moisturizer.

avis.titre: Lightweight, Super Moisturizing Version of My Favorite Cream
avis.texte: Embryolisse Lait-Crème Fluid+ is the ideal lighter counterpart to the classic cream I already love. It feels super moisturizing but has a much more lightweight texture, so it absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy or heavy feeling on the skin. I really like that I can use it on both my face and body, especially on days when I want something hydrating but not too rich. It’s great for everyday use and for warmer weather, or whenever I don’t need a thick cream. If you love the original but want a lighter option, this fluid is a perfect addition.

This moisturizer is awesome! A plus for me is that it has relatively no scent as compared to other moisturizers that I've used that sometimes have too strong of a smell. It leaves my skin feeling very smooth, healthy, and it gives my skin a more vibrant appearance. it is very lightweight and leaves no unwanted film on my skin. This product also has a very clean ingredient profile.

This is the best moisturizer I have ever used. It’s a great value. My skin, which is normal to sensitive at times has never reacted. I love the juicy, healthy glow that it gives! I use it for an all over body moisturizer as well. My daughter has also fallen in love with Embryolisse.

I’m giving it 4 stars because while it is a pleasant and emollient lotion,not the holy grail product that NYTimes Wirecutter seemed to think. Pluses: a mild fragrance makes it work for everyone and it doesn’t leave a greasy feel. Probably better for warmer weather for me; it didn’t hold up in winter weather. Also,strangely,the smell sometimes reminds me of Elmer’s Glue.

Misleading. First off, the bottle definitely was not the same weight as promised. Once opening the container, only half was filled. Second, there was a big tape area where, of course tape had been. But what we had was a lint filled missing mark. The consistency was not the same from what I have ordered so many of times. I have raved about the brand with my friends and had looked forward to my new purchase but I don’t know if I could either try or recommend this again because the of what I received.
I love the scent and texture of the crème which makes an immediate difference on my face.

avis.titre: Softens, smooths, and subs for face wash
avis.texte: Expensive but worth it. I use it as a makeup remover and a body lotion. It has a faint, pleasant scent that fades quickly.

avis.titre: Great all rounder for skin health.
avis.texte: Perfect for base for makeup, dermatitis, eczema and other dry skin conditions. Use anywhere.
Great cream. I keep ordering it as it is great as a body and face cream. And I love the scent.
The best and almost same as the concentrated one. In line with EMBRYOLISSE products. Simply the best

I’ve been using this Embryolisse fluid cream daily, and it’s quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. The texture is light and silky — easily absorbed without leaving any greasy feel — but still super hydrating, even on dry or sensitive skin. It’s great under makeup and doesn’t pill, and I’ve noticed my skin feels softer and more comfortable throughout the day. The pump bottle is convenient and hygienic too. It’s perfect for everyday use on both face and body. Highly recommend if you want a reliable, easy-to-use moisturiser that keeps skin nourished without heaviness!
Me ha encantado...textura, absorción, hidratación...y antes del maquillaje lo deja super bonita la piel.

avis.titre: Best Body Lotion I’ve Tried — Clean Ingredients & Self-Tan Safe
avis.texte: This is easily the best body lotion I’ve used. It scored 100/100 on the Yuka app, which gave me peace of mind about the ingredients. The formula feels rich but not greasy, sinks in quickly, and leaves skin smooth all day. One thing I really appreciate is that it’s spray tan and self-tan safe — no streaking, patchiness, or weird reactions with color. That makes it a great option if you tan regularly and don’t want your lotion to mess with the results. Overall, this lotion checks all the boxes: clean, effective, long-lasting hydration, and safe for daily use (even with self-tanner). Definitely worth it if you want a high-quality, reliable body moisturizer.

Since hitting my 30’s my skin has been going through. Went from having normal skin to having dry/combination skin. I wanted to try something different. I have already switched my facial cleanser so it was time for me to find a good facial moisturizer that I can use and that is not to heavy in the summer time. This works great. Opted for the smaller size since I didn’t know if it would work for me. It has 100/100 Yuka rating so that’s awesome as well. This moisturizer is light but hydrating. Dries down very quick and gives your skin a nice shine.

Got the travel size one and was excited to receive it because I like this lotion but it wasn’t even full AT ALL! For paying the price I paid I would expect it to be fully full. My finger is were the product is at

avis.titre: Great Everyday Moisturizer, but a Bit Pricey
avis.texte: I’ve been using this Embryolisse Lait-Crème Fluid for several months and already bought it three times because it works so well under makeup. It’s lightweight, absorbs quickly, and makes my skin feel soft and smooth without any greasy feeling. My foundation goes on easily and looks natural all day. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because it’s a bit expensive for how fast it runs out, especially if you use it on both face and body. Still, it’s a really nice daily moisturizer that keeps my skin healthy and hydrated.

avis.titre: Leaves skin soft, smooth, and glowing.
avis.texte: The best body cream I’m absolutely impressed with this body cream. The texture is smooth, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin deeply hydrated without feeling greasy. The scent is lovely but not overpowering. I’ve noticed my skin looking softer, more radiant, and well-nourished after just a few uses. It’s truly an excellent product — I highly recommend it!

I really like that it contains shea butter, aloe vera, and glycerin, which keep the skin nourished, and it has a clean ingredient list with no harsh chemicals — even rated 100/100 (Excellent). It also works perfectly under makeup and as an after-sun or after-shave lotion.

I Love this lotion, Embryolisse does not disappoint. I’ve bought the small tube original and I felt in Love with it; I use as a primer before makeup. As always the original is rich and thicker; not heavy. Very moisturizing, mild almost Aloe smell to it. Not Greasy, fast absorbing. Works great, my skin loved it!. Since both tube sizes are small. For a Great Value size I gave Embryolisse Lotion with pump 16oz a try, Since it’s a Lotion; consistency changes to more liquid and thin, but not runny if it makes sense; compared to the original concentrate. I’m not gonna lie… I Love them both!!! I recommend this 100%See for yourself, Do try both!!

avis.texte: 0 estrellas ! Me parece vergonzoso esta crema no viene sellada y viene por la mitad de crema

avis.texte: I am looking for Mistral lait corporel extra rich body lotion, as seen in the photo below. Is the lait cream they offer now the same fragrance? Light and lovely. I’ve had mine for quite some time and would like to buy more.

I’m not sure what I was expecting but this is just very average type of moisturizer that didn’t wow me in any possible way. As far as as scent, really didn’t mind it, my skin didn’t have any type of reaction after using it so it’s safe to say that I can use it on my face but I just don’t trust it… it’s not super moisturizing, I feel like it’s in the lighter side of things with me personally needing good coverage as far as keeping my skin smooth. Also please note that this is a very small bottle so if using as body cream for me personally it would last maybe 2-3 times. I’m just not super impressed with it, maybe because I had a higher expectations for it.

avis.titre: The cream goes a long way, a dime sized amount went over my whole face, hands and arms.
avis.texte: Embryolisse Lait Creme Fluid Face & Body Cream. Lightweight Moisturizer for All Skin Types. Hydrating Lotion with Shea Butter & Aloe Vera First impressions: Nice bottle of moisturizer with a pump top. Turn the top to open so you can dispense the cream. It does have a fragrance, like something my grandmother would have loved. Kind of floral? Maybe a rose? Installation/setup: Use as a moisturizer on damp clean skin. Final thoughts: I’ve been using this on my face and neck. It takes a bit to rub it in but it works if you keep at it. The cream goes a long way, a dime sized amount went over my whole face, hands and arms. My face feels nice and my neck especially likes this cream. I’m getting older and it’s really showing in my skin texture on my hands and neck. I like this and I’m glad I got it. ⭐️1 star - I don't recommend it at all, poor quality. ⭐️⭐️ 2 stars - I don't recommend it, it has multiple faults, or a very high price. ⭐️⭐️⭐️ 3 stars - It's passable, It has some faults but the quality is ok for what it is. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 4 stars - Product quite acceptable, it does what it promises. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5 stars - Product that I totally recommend.

avis.titre: Feels lovely and I like the throwback scent [Embryolisse Lait-Crème Fluide+ 2.54oz]
avis.texte: Embryolisse’s Lait-Crème Fluide+ is not something that I would normally go for, but I was swayed by the fact that it is a French brand that has been around since 1950, can be used on the face and body, AND it is TSA check-in sized. The first day I thought it was a bit dry on my face (I’m used to oil packed creams), but after a couple of days, my skin has acclimated, and I am really enjoying it! It looks like some reviewers hate the fragrance, but I really like the throwback floral scent too. (I know it's better to stick to unscented products, but this really smells lovely to me.) The ingredient list is also pretty decent with only two items scoring above three on EWG’s database: fragrance and sodium hydroxide (ingredient used in making soap): AQUA (WATER). CAPRYLIC/CAPRIC TRIGLYCERIDE. OCTYLDODECANOL. GLYCERIN. CETEARYL GLUCOSIDE. BUTYROSPERMUM PARKII (SHEA) BUTTER. CERA ALBA (BEESWAX). SORBITAN OLIVATE. ALOE BARBADENSIS LEAF JUICE POWDER. XANTHAN GUM. PARFUM (FRAGRANCE). 1,2-HEXANEDIOL. CAPRYLYL GLYCOL. CETEARYL ALCOHOL. ACRYLATES/C10-30 ALKYL ACRYLATE CROSSPOLYMER. SODIUM HYDROXIDE. HYDROLYZED SOY PROTEIN. TOCOPHEROL. TROPOLONE. GLYCINE SOJA (SOYBEAN) OIL.

avis.titre: Half Full Bottle With Broken Pump
avis.texte: I got this Embryolisse Lait Creme Fluid Face & Body Cream because it was marketed as a moisturizer for all skin types. It arrived in a pump bottle with no leaks; however, the plastic guard to prevent leaks was missing. Unfortunately, the pump came broken, as I could not even get it to pop up, so the guard wouldn't have helped anyway. Now, I am stuck having to twist off the pump part every time I want to use it. The bottle also came half full, so I'm not sure this is worth the price for this little product. As for the cream itself, I found it to be quite liquidy and have a very strong perfume scent. As someone who is sensitive to smell and has sensitive skin with eczema, I did some patch tests on my arms first. The cream was moisturizing and did not irritate my eczema, but I would not apply it to my face since the scent seemed to linger for a while. Overall, I do not see myself purchasing this product when I run out.

It was a little difficult to get open and when I did some shot out all over so be careful when forst opening. Its a but think in consistency and a little go's a long way. It doesn't leave any greasy feeling or film behind and my skin feels hydrated and soft after. I know some people can't do heavy scents and this DOES have that old lady smell to it. Like, grandma's perfume....However, the smell doesn't seem to last longer than a few minuets and doesn't seem to linger on the skin.

Unfortunately, this cream has such a heavy fragrance and I am not able to use it. I am glad they have a smaller size that I was able to try first. The cream seems like a thinner consistency when I pumped out a small test. It arrived without a box or seal of any kind, but the bottle pump does turn and lock.

avis.titre: Filled to less than half bottle
avis.texte: Literally received this moisturizer filled a little less than half the bottle. I have not tried the creme on my skin yet. I hope it's worth it. I don't expect it to last long since there isn't much in it to start.
My bridal makeup artist introduced me to this moisturizer and I’ve never looked back. I love the scent, quality and longevity. My face is so clear and soft.

avis.titre: No viene la cantidad que se anuncia en la descripción, muy caro para pagar envase
avis.texte: El producto parece bueno pero el envase viene con el producto a la mitad del frasco, si el frasco es de 2.54 FL.OZ y el producto viene a por la mitad del envase no estamos comprando esa cantidad por el precio que pagamos, estamos pagando envase. Por favor tengan en cuenta este gran detalle. Pensaba comprar uno más grande pero si viene a la mitad del envase la crema, no es justo, no es barato, además no se acepta devolución.

I have used this product religiously for YEARS and this is not the same. I’ve always ordered from the manufacturer through Amazon. This says “new packaging, same formula” but it isn’t -just compare the ingredients! It wreaks of lilac and doesn’t absorb well. Sits on the skin, stinking. I emptied the entire refill into my old bottle and got a bit on my hands in the process and noticed right away that it wasn’t the same. Had to wash my hands with soap to get the stink off. I LOVED this product and I am honestly devastated. I get horrible migraines and am glad I didn’t slather this on my face before I realized. I don’t understand why these crazy popular companies change their formula! Like, you’re popular FOR A REASON! I included pics of the ingredients from my old bottle, my travel bottle, and the new refill bag (which is a GREAT idea) (if only it was filled with the original formula) 😩 Now, how to get a refund? Can I send back an empty bag? So frustrating.

So I had bought a small bottle of this to try it and see if I liked it. I did like it and ran out and decided to order more. Unfortunately, it is not the same lotion that I had before they changed the formula and now this cream leaves, my face feeling greasy, and as if it’s sitting on top of my face instead of absorbing, the old one orbed and left a nice smooth non-greasy finish so if you were looking for the same lotion, this is not it. You’ll be very disappointed. I have attached a picture of the ingredients in my old one and the ingredients in my new one and they are very different its now fluide+ not just fluide. I have no doubt that this change was to save money unfortunately the product suffers because of it.
A very nice light cream, very nice slight smell, not overpowering.
